desc:
The Register of Members and Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from 19.09.2026 to 25.09.2026 (both days inclusive)  for taking record of the Members of the Company for the purpose of 39th AGM to be held on 25.09.2026 at 11.00 a.m.
Cutoff date - 18.09.2026
Evoting period ; 22.09.2026 to 24.09.2026
Evoting Time : 9.00 am and End 5.00 pm
Notice of 39th AGM to be held on 25th Sep 2026 at 11.a.m through Video Conferencing/ Other Audio Visual Means in accordance with the relevant circulars issued by the MCA and SEBI.

The Company informed that the 39th AGM of the Company is scheduled to be held on Friday, the 25th Sep 2026 at 11.00 am through Video Conferencing/ other Audio Visual means in accordance with Circulars issued by the MCA and SEBI.  The Annual Report containing 39th AGM is also uploaded on the Companies Website and the same shall also be available  on the website of CDSL.

Pursuant to Reg 36(1)(b) of the SEBI Listing Regulations the Company has dispartched a letter to those Members who have not registered their email addresses with the Company Register and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) or Depositories.  The letter contains a web link for accessing the Notice of the 39th AGM and Annual Report for the Fy 2025-26.
Reg 47 of SEBI LODR Reg 2015 the has published  the 39th Annual General Meeting Notice to shareholders to be held on 25th September 2026 in the newspaper.
